text.autoconfig.collisiondamage.title: Collision Damage
text.autoconfig.collisiondamage.option.a: How large the player's deceleration must be before they begin taking damage (measured in m/s).
text.autoconfig.collisiondamage.option.d: Multiplies the damage taken over the threshold. Default 1.0x is 1 damage per 1 m/s over threshold.
Use the FLY_INTO_WALL damage type. If false, uses FALL (so feather falling, etc. also affects collision damage).
text.autoconfig.collisiondamage.option.m: Maximum damage per hit. Set to 0 for no cap.
text.autoconfig.collisiondamage.option.i: Skip collision damage while riding (boats, horses, etc.).
Skip collision damage while in water.
Include Y axis collision damage from upward impacts.
text.autoconfig.collisiondamage.option.d: Damage the vehicle when the rider triggers collision damage.
text.autoconfig.collisiondamage.option.g: Apply collision damage to all living entities, not just players.
